description_en: Queries the details of a single storage object in OSS that is authorized for connection to Data Security Center
description_zh: 调用本接口查询数据安全中心连接授权的OSS的单个存储对象的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun sddp describe-oss-object-detail-v2 --lang zh_cn --id 12300 --service-region-id cn-hangzhou --bucket-name sddp-api-scan-demo --object-key dir1/test.png --template-id 1 --api-version 2019-01-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeOssObjectDetailV2

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: zh_cn. Valid values:

zh_cn: Simplified Chinese.
en_us: English (US)
parameters.help_zh:
Set the language type for request and response messages. Default value: zh_cn. Values:

zh_cn: Simplified Chinese
en_us: English (US)
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The unique ID of the OSS storage object.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/410152.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
The unique identifier ID of the OSS storage object.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/410152.html interface to get the ID
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The service region ID, which is the region ID of the bucket
parameters.help_zh: Service region ID, which is the region ID where the Bucket is located
parameters.name: service_region_id

parameters.help_en: The full name of the file stored in OSS
parameters.help_zh: The full file name of the file stored on OSS
parameters.name: object_key

parameters.help_en:
The industry template ID.
Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2399296.html operation to obtain the industry template ID
parameters.help_zh:
Industry template ID.
You can obtain the industry template ID by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2399296.html
parameters.name: template_id
